hooks.name: Collection catalogue sync check
hooks.description: When a main game document changes, check its catalogue properties against the overview and public index.

action.prompt: A possible game record was edited. Read AGENTS.md, repository-structure.md, and Project/ADDING_A_GAME.md. If the file has record_type: game, validate its state (In development, Ready to test, Proven, or Shelved), physically_playtested, exact players and bounds, readable and numeric duration, complexity, genre, public_document, and next_step. Compare the synchronized fields with its complete-table entry in COLLECTION_OVERVIEW.md and object in games.html. If this is a new game, offer to add those two derived entries, update displayed collection totals, create the links, and assign the next catalog_order. GAME_CATALOG.base reads the record automatically. State exact mismatches and make no unrelated edits.
